class.name: HTMLVideoElement
class.brief_description: A video element with optional playback and fullscreen controls.
class.description: An [HTMLLabel] owns the playback session for a connected video. Projects can install compatible VLC or FFmpeg add-ons to decode local video.

method.name: exit_fullscreen
method.description: Closes the video fullscreen presentation and keeps the current playback session.

method.name: is_fullscreen
method.description: Returns whether the video is presented in fullscreen.

method.name: pause
method.description: Pauses video playback at the current position.

method.name: play
method.description: Requests playback. Returns [constant ERR_UNAVAILABLE] when the requested backend is missing.

method.name: request_fullscreen
method.description: Opens a separate fullscreen window on a supported desktop or fills the host viewport. Returns [constant ERR_BUSY] if another video is fullscreen in the same host window.

method.name: seek
method.description: Requests a seek to [param seconds]. The target is clamped to the video duration. Returns [constant ERR_UNAVAILABLE] when seeking is unavailable.

members.member: Starts playback automatically at runtime. Editor previews require user input.

Requests built-in controls. The video prepares its intrinsic size before playback, including in the editor. The video is drawn black and its controls are disabled when no selected backend is available.
The original local resource path of the selected video.
The current playback position in seconds. Use [method seek] to change it.
The video duration in seconds, or zero while unknown.
The HTML height attribute in CSS pixels.
Restarts the video when it reaches the end.
Whether video audio is muted. The HTML attribute supplies the initial state.
Whether video playback is paused or stopped.
The local poster image displayed before a video frame is available.
The local video source. If omitted, the player tries the child [code]<source>[/code] elements in order.
The intrinsic video height in pixels, or zero while unknown.
The intrinsic video width in pixels, or zero while unknown.
Linear video audio volume from [code]0.0[/code] to [code]1.0[/code].
The HTML width attribute in CSS pixels.
